checks.name: build
command: source /opt/ros/foxy/setup.bash && export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 MAKEFLAGS=-j2 ROS_DOMAIN_ID=161 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 ROS_HOME=/work/ros_home ROS_LOG_DIR=/work/ros_logs && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/work/dependencies/osqp-install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-} && cd /work && colcon --log-base logs/v291-attempt02 build --base-paths src --executor sequential --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE="-O3 -DNDEBUG -g1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3

checks.name: unit
command: source /opt/ros/foxy/setup.bash && export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 MAKEFLAGS=-j2 ROS_DOMAIN_ID=161 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 ROS_HOME=/work/ros_home ROS_LOG_DIR=/work/ros_logs && source /work/install/setup.bash && export ROUTE_ORACLE=/work/fixtures/route-oracle.yaml PCT_TEST_MAP=/work/fixtures/flat.pct TERRAIN_TEST_MANIFEST=/work/fixtures/building/terrain.json TERRAIN_TEST_DIRECTORY=/work/fixtures/building TERRAIN_NATIVE_CONFIG=/work/fixtures/building_planner.yaml TERRAIN_NATIVE_PROFILE=/work/fixtures/component.scan.yaml TERRAIN_TEST_PROFILE=/work/fixtures/component.yaml FEEDBACK_OUTPUT=/evaluation/feedback_output && cd /work && colcon --log-base logs/v291-test-attempt02 test --base-paths src --executor sequential --event-handlers console_direct+ --return-code-on-test-failure --ctest-args -E "^(cpplint|uncrustify|xmllint)$"
